description: This file defines HDMI CEC-related constants, data structures, classes representing CEC frames, messages, exceptions, and interfaces for connection and message encoding/decoding within a HDMI CEC communication project.

classes.name: CECFrame
classes.description: Represents a CEC frame, manages buffer and length, provides singleton access.

classes.name: CECBytes
classes.description: Base class for CEC data bytes, provides serialization and comparison.

classes.name: OSDString
classes.description: Represents On-Screen Display String, derived from CECBytes.

classes.name: OSDName
classes.description: Represents OSD Name, derived from CECBytes.

classes.name: AbortReason
classes.description: Represents the cause for aborting a CEC message.

classes.name: DeviceType
classes.description: Enumerates device types in CEC protocol, with string conversion.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Represents language codes for CEC.

classes.name: VendorID
classes.description: Represents vendor ID as 3-byte code.

classes.name: PhysicalAddress
classes.description: Represents physical address in CEC, with getter for bytes.

classes.name: LogicalAddress
classes.description: Enumerates logical device addresses, with type mapping.

classes.name: Version
classes.description: Represents CEC version.

classes.name: PowerStatus
classes.description: Represents power status of a device.

classes.name: UICommand
classes.description: Represents user interface commands for remote control.

classes.name: AllDeviceTypes
classes.description: Aggregates device type flags.

classes.name: RcProfile
classes.description: Represents remote control profile.

classes.name: DeviceFeatures
classes.description: Device feature flags.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: Represents message header with source and destination addresses.

classes.name: ActiveSource
classes.description: Represents an active source in CEC.

classes.name: InActiveSource
classes.description: Represents an inactive source.

classes.name: ReportPhysicalAddress
classes.description: Contains physical address and device type info.

classes.name: ReportPowerStatus
classes.description: Contains power status info.

classes.name: OpCode
classes.description: Represents a CEC OpCode message.

classes.name: FeatureAbort
classes.description: Represents a feature abort message.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Interface for managing HDMI CEC connection and communication.

classes.name: LibCCEC
classes.description: Singleton for CEC library interface, manages initialization and addresses.

classes.name: RequestCurrentLatency
classes.description: Requests current latency information.

classes.name: ReportCurrentLatency
classes.description: Reports latency information.

classes.name: MessageDecoder
classes.description: Decodes CEC frames into messages, uses implementation interface.

classes.name: MessageEncoder
classes.description: Encodes messages into CEC frames, uses implementation interface.

classes.name: Exception
classes.description: Base exception class.

classes.name: IOException
classes.description: Represents IO errors.

classes.name: InvalidStateException
classes.description: Represents invalid state errors.

methods.name: getLogicalAddress
methods.description: Get logical device address for a device type.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decode a CEC frame into message.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encode a message into CEC frame.
